title: Configure and Support Sales Analytics Dashboard
original_text: Services Provider will configure and support a sales analytics dashboard for Customer, including data import, dashboard setup, user training and monthly technical support. The initial implementation is expected to be completed within 30 calendar days after the Effective Date.
plain_language_explanation: The Services Provider will set up and maintain a sales analytics dashboard for the Customer, including importing data, setting up the dashboard, training users, and providing monthly technical support. This setup is expected to be completed within 30 days after the Effective Date.

title: Payment of Implementation Fee
trigger_condition: on signing and on completion of implementation
original_text: Customer will pay Provider a fixed implementation fee of INR 4,80,000 (Indian Rupees Four Lakh Eighty Thousand), exclusive of applicable taxes. Provider will invoice 50% on signing and 50% on completion of implementation. Each undisputed invoice is payable within 30 calendar days of receipt.
plain_language_explanation: The Customer will pay the Provider a fixed implementation fee of INR 4,80,000, excluding applicable taxes. The Provider will invoice 50% of the fee upon signing and 50% upon completion of the implementation. Each undisputed invoice must be paid within 30 days of receipt.
